title: Dorian
description: Initially located downstairs, but will move upstairs after completing the My White-Haired Angel side quest.

title: Headband
description: In the corner of the footpath at the end of the canal. Grants immunity to Sleep. _A cloth band that keeps fatigue away when tied firmly around the head._

title: Bulletproof Vest
description: Type: Accessory On top of a ledge reached with the pushable mine cart. _A vest favored by many a Shinra trooper._

title: Power Wristguards
description: Part of the [Shinra Construction Site Cache](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323902). Increases Strength by 5%. _Wristguards capable of drawing out power latent in the wearer's body._

title: Salvation Badge
description: Part of the [Cargo Shipwreck Cache](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323920). Increases the effectiveness of healing items and spells applied to you when HP is 25% or lower. _A distinguished emblem that purportedly lifts all burdens from the wearer's shoulders._

title: Survival Vest
description: NOTICE: This Item is _missable_ as you cannot return to it after the Chapter 4 boss. In the back corner of the dressing room. Increases Vitality by 10%. _An industrial-grade bulletproof vest issued to only the most elite of Shinra forces._

title: Revival Earrings
description: NOTICE: This Item is _missable_ as you cannot return to it after the Chapter 4 boss. After the fight in the warmly-lit mess hall, you'll go down some stairs. At the bottom, exit and turn right to face a railing, which this chest on the left side of it. Grants Auto-Life at the start of battle. Breaks upon use. _Earrings imbued with a spirit capable of restoring one's fading consciousness._

title: Speed Demon Keychain
description: Awarded for making it to Roche with all five 7th Infantry Troopers alive. Slightly replenishes ATB gauge when using a weapon ability. _An official keychain produced by passionate fans of the motorcycle madman Roche._

title: Assess Materia Earrings
description: Win the surprise exhibition match at the end of the Queen's Blood tournament. Allows use of the highest level of Assess materia, granting the ability to scan all enemies in the field. Winning will also get you two Queen's Blood cards for free: - Card #065: Ifrit - Card #115: Terror of the Deep _Earrings which incorporate an orb of Assess materia into the design, allowing the wearer to avail themselves of its magic.

title: Circlet
description: In the northern corner of the Part of the [Seabreeze Storehouse](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323820), next to the chrome tanker truck. Increases max MP by 10%, and magic power by 5%. _A circlet said to have been worn by a fairy-tale sorceress._

title: Healing Carcanet
description: On the shoreline under the [Cape del Amor](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323804) pier. To get here, swim through the gap in the pier's supports, at the far end of the pier. Increases the effectiveness of healing items, spells, and abilities during battle. _An elaborate neckpiece that imparts peace of mind to the wearer._

title: Safety Bit
description: Inside the shack between the tracks. You can either climb up from the western tracks, or slide down the zipline on the eastern tracks. Grants immunity to Instant Death, Stone and Petrify. _A security encryption designed to protect against multiple magical viruses._

title: Ice Materia Earrings
description: Part of the [Sundappled Storehouses Cache site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=324224). Allows use of the highest level of Ice materia, granting access to the spells Blizzard, Blizzara, and Blizzaga. _Earrings which incorporate an orb of ice materia into the design, allowing the wearer to avail themselves of its magic._

title: Poison Materia Earrings
description: Part of the [Reactor Construction Site Cache site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=329503). Allows use of the highest level of Poison materia, granting access to the spells Bio, Biora and Bioga. _Earrings which incorporate an orb of Poison materia into the design, allowing the wearer to avail themselves of its magic._

title: Protective Boots
description: Part of the [Cliffside Storehouse Cache site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=329432). Grants immunity to Slow and Stop. _Boots developed for soldiers fighting in rugged terrain._

title: Aureate Pinion
description: Located behind the main barn, among some supplies on the perimeter fence. Increases Speed by 10. _A glimmering chocobo feather gilt for decorative purposes._

title: Revival Earrings
description: On top of the arched wall with the climbable rock wall to the left of it. Grants Auto-Life at the start of battle. Breaks upon use. _Earrings imbued with a spirit capable of restoring one's fading consciousness._

title: Timeworn Talisman
description: On top of the wall at the bottom of the long staircase. Increases Spirit by 10%. _A talisman said to have once been in daily use among the Ancients._

title: Gi Warrior's Charm
description: *WARNING:* This Accessory is _missable!_ If you do not get it before returning the Ruby Gi Statue to Bugenhagen, it will be inaccessible until you unlock Chapter Select! Found as a large arrowhead (almost like the top of a spear) in the debris in the middle of the room. Increases the Limit Gauge fill rate by 10%. _A charm once worn by a Gi champion that served as a constant reminder of the righteousness of their cause._

title: Fortification Earrings
description: From the [Sapphire Chest](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348749), climb up the wall to the top, then go left down the ledge. Towards the wooden planks you can cross will be this chest. Allows the use of the highest level of Fortification materia, granting access to the spells Protect and Shell. _Earrings which incorporate an orb of Fortification materia into the design, allowing the wearer to avail themselves of its magic._

title: Revival Earrings
description: After freeing Aerith and Barret and defeating the Black Bats, roll through the vent gap in the southwestern wall of the room, then look right to spot this chest. Grants Auto-Life at the start of battle. Breaks upon use. _Earrings imbued with a spirit capable of restoring one's fading consciousness._

title: Enchanted Ring
description: In Hojo's secret laboratory. Unlock it by completing all Evaluation challenges in the [Mako Research Combat Simulator](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348951). Extends the duration of beneficial status effects applied by the wearer. _A magic ring that ensnares the heart and mind of any who look upon it._

title: Whistlewind Scarf
description: In the blue Azurestar Chamber to turn gravity. Turn gravity upside-down so you walk on the ceiling, then find it in the southeast corner of the chamber. Slightly fills the ATB gauge at the start of battle. _A scarf that makes the wearer feel as if the wind is at their back._

title: Revival Materia Earrings
description: In the second Cloud section, after destructively forging a way across the second gap, make your way across, then make a U-turn to the left and go down the rubble. This chest will be at the bottom. Allows use of the highest level of Ice materia, granting access to the spells Raise and Arise. _Earrings which incorporate an orb of Revival materia into the design, allowing the wearer to avail themselves of its magic._

title: Disempowerment Materia Earrings
description: Prerequisite: Progress [Airstrip Amblers](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=345881) In the second chamber under the airstrip will be a submarine. Use your Chocobo and a puddle of water to Chocojet on top of it. Find the ladder in the middle and use it to drop into a small room with this chest in it.

title: Beastman Armband
description: Part of the [Mistveil Reservoir Cache](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=324221). _Grade II: An avant-garde armband made from the shavings of a beastman's club._ Materia Slots: 2 Defense: 11 Magic Defense: 24

title: Illusionist's Armband
description: An involved chest to reach. From the Cockatrice, face east and climb up the yellow handholds on the wooden wall. Head to the end of the walkway, then turn right to spot a bucket to cut with Yuffie's weapon, dropping a ladder. Slide down the nearby pole to get back onto the ground, then climb up the ladder. Around the corner of this walkway, use the grapple points on the metal pipe above to swing over to the upper ledge with this chest on it! _Grade VI: A perfectly unassuming armband that proves the wearer has nothing to hide._ Materia Slots: 2 (1 pair) Defense: 20 Magic Defense: 43

title: Swallowsong Bracer
description: Part of the [Rustladen Reservoir cache site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323827). _Grade VI: A finely crafted bracer that evokes the beauty of a bird in flight._ Materia Slots: 3 (1 pair) Defense: 27 Magic Defense: 27

title: Big Horn Bracelet
description: Part of the [Watchmans's Lookout Cache site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=328248). _Grade VIII: An imposing bracelet fashioned with a horn taken from a large beast._ Materia Slots: 3 (1 pair) Defense: 32 Magic Defense: 32

title: Sage Armband
description: In the Coolant Control room, swim across to the pair of staircases. Instead of using them, head down the left-hand side and down the ladder. Climb up the ruined walkway on the left to find this chest at the top. Warning: Open this chest _before_ raising the water level, or it will be inaccessible. _Grade VIII: An armband crafted by a wise man of the woods who prayed that the will of the planet would guide him true._ Materia Slots: 3 Defense: 24 Magic Defense: 51

title: Backbone Bracelet
description: On top of the shipwreck. Part of [The Celestica Cache Site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=324226). _Grade X: A bracelet which incorporates the vertebrae of a fearsome fiend to bolster one's defense._ Materia Slots: 5 (2 pairs) Defense: 27 Magic Defense: 58

title: Celestial Bangle
description: Scamper clockwise around the walls of this room to reach this chest on a ledge with a blocked archway. _Grade X: A mystical bangle that evokes the boundless majesty and wisdom of the heavens._ Materia Slots: 6 (1 pair) Defense: 58 Magic Defense: 27

title: Valkyrian Bangle
description: Part of the [Nidhogg Grotto Cache site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=345697). Found in the tunnel under this peak of the island. _Grade XII: A stunning bangle crafted to capture the glory and divinity of the goddesses drawn to the fires of war._ Materia Slots: 6 (2 pairs) Defense: 64 Magic Defense: 30

title: Hades Armlet
description: On your left when you first roll up the red vent and arrive in Materials Storage. _Grade XII: A terrible armlet created by a conjurer at the behest of a conqueror who sought to triumph over death itself._ Materia Slots: 7 (3 pairs) Defense: 32 Magic Defense: 32

title: Cetran Bangle
description: After jumping down the waterfall, head up several staircases and enter the purple Mauvestar Chamber. Use the crystal to pull gravity sideways, then climb up the vines and then go up the stairs. Kill the Ancient Dragon and open the chest it was guarding. _Grade XIII: A bangle that embodies the resolute will of the Ancients and confers supreme physical defense._ Materia Slots: 0 Defense: 67 Magic Defense: 32

title: Cetran Armband
description: At the third altar, Order's Altar, restore the southeastern Vessel of Life to restore the Joy's Ascent tower. Climb up the tower's stairs to find this chest at the top. If the chest isn't there, you'll have to go back to the second altar (Mercy's Altar) and restore the top of the tower to the east of it. _Grade XIII: An armband that embodies the vast knowledge of the Ancients and confers supreme magical defense._ Materia Slots: 0 Defense: 32 Magic Defense: 67

title: Cetran Armlet
description: After partially restoring the environment at Salvation's Altar, head west into the tower, north to fight some Berserker Bees, west onto a broken bridge, then south and west to an area with Berserker Bees and Blight Frogs. The chest will be on the northern edge of this area. _Grade XIII: An armlet that embodies the hopes and dreams of the Ancients and unlocks the full potential of materia._ Materia Slots: 8 (4 pairs) Defense: 33 Magic Defense: 33

title: Cetran Bracer
description: From the [Fuma Shuriken](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=351867), head south and around the corner to fight a Floating Death enemy. It's guarding the chest on the east side of the room. _Grade XIII: A bracer that embodies the ethos of the Ancients and confers incredible benefits._ Materia Slots: 8 (4 pairs) Defense: 42 Magic Defense: 42

description: Part of the [Nidhogg Grotto Cache chest](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=345698). _Cures all detrimental status effects._

title: Giga-Potion
description: Part of the [Cliffs of Abjuration Cache site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=345695). _Restores 3,000 HP._

title: Elixir
description: On the upper floor of the barn, between the fireplace and a leather chair. _Fully restores HP and MP._

title: Mist Mega-Potion
description: NOTICE: This chest is only available during Chapter 11. It cannot be acquired during Chapter 1. On the upper floor of the Nidhogg Hotel, where Cloud has a private cutscene. It's in the corner across from the bed. _Restores 1,500 HP to all allies._

title: Elixir
description: NOTICE: This chest only appears during Chapter 11. It is not present during Chapter 1. At the foot of the cliff near the river. _Fully restores HP and MP._

title: X-Potion
description: From the [Fortification Earrings Chest](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348750), head left across the wooden planks, then climb up the two yellow handholds on the other side. At the top, drop down left and head around the corner to find this chest. _Fully restores HP._

title: Hi-Ether
description: On the second-to-last floor of the Mako Distribution Plant's pipe maze. To get here, slide down to the cramped third floor with many Shinra Boxes to slash. From here, locate the pairs of pipes heading downwards and go down the right-hand pipe (it doesn't matter which pair your choose). At the bottom, defeat the two [Screamers](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348755), then find the chest on the North side of this floor. _Restores 50 MP._

title: Giga-Potion
description: After defeating the Twin Brains, head through the wooden door, then turn left and go all the way to the end to find this chest. _Restores 3,000 HP._

title: Giga-Potion
description: After clearing the first elevator, riding it up, and killing the Black Bats and Bahba Velamyu, head through the duct on the northeastern wall. Defeat the Black Bat and Bahba Velamyu on the other side, then check the southern side-room for this chest. _Restores 3,000 HP._

title: Dry Ether
description: After the [1,700 gil](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348772) and rolling up to Ventilation Control - 2F, head forward and turn right to find this chest at the end of the railing. _Restores 100 MP._

title: Giga-Potion
description: After the [Aim for the Crates](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348842), check the southern corner of the next room, on the raised section. Pull out the trolley of boxes to expose a ladder that can be used to climb up to this chest. _Restores 3,000 HP._

title: Turbo Ether
description: In the antiquated side room of the Underground Cavern, where you have a cutscene shortly after control switches from Cait Sith to Cloud. _Fully restores MP._

title: Turbo Ether
description: In Hojo's secret laboratory. Unlock it by completing all Evaluation challenges in the [Mako Research Combat Simulator](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348951). _Fully restores MP._

title: X-Potion
description: In Hojo's secret laboratory. Unlock it by completing all Evaluation challenges in the [Mako Research Combat Simulator](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348951). _Fully restores HP._

title: 2x Mist Mega-Potions
description: On the western side of the Keystone plaza, just before the wooden bridge into the Temple of the Ancients. _Restores 1,500 HP to all allies._

title: X-Potion
description: On the eastern corner of the structure in the middle of the eastern bridge. _Fully restores HP._

title: Dry Ether
description: On the western corner of the structure in the middle of the western bridge. _Restores 100 MP._

title: 2x Giga-Potions
description: After the opening cutscene in the Labyrinth, make a U-turn to the right and go all the way to the end of the walkway to find this chest. _Restores 3,000 HP._

title: Hi-Ether
description: After turning gravity back to the floor in the Jadestar Chamber, exit the chamber and go to the southwest corner to find this chest. _Restores 50 MP._

title: X-Potion
description: After walking past the sideway green waterfall, turn left when you get to the staircase. Go through the archway to find the chest, across the arena guarded by a Cthonilizard and two Blight Frogs. _Fully restores HP._

title: Giga-Potion
description: At the scene on the aqueduct where you see two soldiers jump down the waterfall, head northwest from the waterfall to find this chest at the end of the walkway. _Restores 3,000 HP._

title: 2x Giga-Potions
description: After crossing the bridge that collapses as you go across, find this chest on the eastern side of the ring-shaped room on the other side of the bridge. _Restores 3,000 HP._

title: Hi-Ether
description: Found early in the first Aerith / Yuffie section. At the second altar, Mercy's Altar, restore the top of the tower to the east, called Joy's Ascent. The chest will be in the southwestern corner of the tower. You cannot get [the chest](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=351436) in the northeastern corner until later on in this section. _Restores 50 MP._

title: Elixir
description: At the third altar, Order's Altar, restore the eastern-most Vessel of Life to restore the Viruous Font area. Check behind the font (the pool of water) to find this chest. _Fully restores HP and MP._

title: Mist Giga-Potion
description: In the second Cloud section, after destructively forging a way across the second gap, make your way across, then turn right and go all the to the end to find this chest. _Restores 3,000 HP to all allies._

title: X-Potion
description: After defeating the Moss-Grown Adamantoise, proceed into the next room and check the raised area in the middle for this chest. _Fully restores HP._

title: Elixir
description: After the Moss-Grown Adamantoise, process through the next room to return to the spiral staircase. Turn left and climb up it, and you'll find this chest among the rubble blocking your way further up. This is the final chest in the entire game! _Fully restores HP and MP._

title: Lv. 1 Precision Defense Focus Materia
description: Type: Complete Materia (Purple) On the tiny rock island in the middle of the bay. _Improves the functionality of blocking with perfect timing._

title: Lv. 1 Item Master Materia
description: Type: Complete Materia (Purple) On the wooden dock in the waters of the cave. _Increases the effectiveness of items used in battle._

title: Lv. 1 Cleansing Materia
description: Type: Magic Materia (Green) Prerequisite: Progress the [When the Wind Blows](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325883) side quest. Drops out of this windmill after returning the Windmill Gear part to Mildred during the When the Wind Blows side quest.. _Allows you to use curative spells._

title: Lv. 1 AP Up Materia
description: Type: Command Materia (Blue) Next to the metal steps at the end of this walkway, close to a ladder to the lower floor. _Increases the amount of AP earned for linked Materia._

title: Lv. 1 MP Up Materia
description: Type: Complete Materia (Purple) At the top of these ledges in the section you explore as Barret and Red XIII. _Increases your max MP. This bonus cannot exceed +30% when more than one is equipped._

title: Lv. 1 Lightning Materia
description: Type: Magic Materia (Green) Through the gate that Aerith opens up for Barret and Red XIII. _Allows you to use Lightning magic._

title: Lv. 1 Enervation Materia
description: Type: Magic Materia (Green) On rock ledge you can reach using a rickety wooden walkway. _Allows you to use physical and magic defense-reducing spells. Pairing with Warding Materia grants resistance to physical and magic defense reduction._

title: Lv. 1 MP Up Materia
description: Type: Complete Materia (Purple) On a lookout ledge, accessed via a tunnel from the large clearing to the north. _Increases your max MP. This bonus cannot exceed +30% when more than one is equipped._

title: Lv. 1 Empowerment Materia
description: Type: Magic Materia (Green) At the upper-most floon, on the left after using the yellow ascension cable. _Allows you to use physical and magic attack-strengthening spells. Pairing with Warding Materia grants resistance to physical and magic attack reduction._

title: Lv. 1 Binding Materia
description: Type: Magic Materia (Green) Requires: Start [Of Robed Men and Ransoms](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325424) In the northwest corner of the Central Colliery room. _Allows you to use disruptive spells._

title: Lv. 1 Chakra Materia
description: Type: Command Materia (Yellow) On an exterior food stall, accessed through the doorway next to the piano. _Allows you to restore your own HP and cure Poison with Chakra. The amount restored is relative to damage received—the lower your HP, the more that is restored._

title: Lv. 1 Lightning Materia
description: Type: Magic Materia (Green) On the upper floor of the Inn Under Junon. Head all the way to the end of the hallway, then look right to find it next to the fireplace. _Allows you to use Lightning magic._

title: Lv. 1 HP Up Materia
description: Type: Complete (Purple) In the drydock area accessible in Under Junon's Coastline area. It will be on the left-hand side of the left-hand boat. _Increases your max HP. This bonus cannot exceed +30% when more than one is equipped._

title: Lv. 1 Fortification Materia
description: Type: Magic (Green) On the southern exterior deck of the Royal Lounge (the room where you can sign up for / forfeit the Queen's Blood Tournament). _Allows you to use physical and magic defense-strengthening spells. Pairing with warding materia grants resistance to physical and magic defense reduction._

title: Lv. 1 Revival Materia
description: Type: Magic (Green) On this ledge with a shack on it. Get here by going through a hole in the wooden fence across from Dr. Sheiran's clinic. _Allows you to use revival spells._

title: Lv. 1 Healing Materia
description: Type: Magic (Green) In the Staff room, between the ropeway room and the stairs down to the Park Central area of the saucer. _Allows you to use healing spells._

title: Lv. 1 Steadfast Block Materia
description: Type: Complete Materia (Purple) On the curved walkway at the southwestern-most point of the central plaza. Head up one of the escelators at this end, then turn right towards the Speed Square sign. _Further decreases enemy damage and fills the ATB Gauge faster when guarding._

title: Lv. 3 HP Up Materia
description: Type: Complete (Purple) In front of the seats closest to the stage, on the right-hand side of the theater. _Increases your max HP. This bonus cannot exceed +30% when more than one is equipped._

title: Lv. 1 Poison Materia
description: Type: Magic (Green) After encountering the Sandhog Pies at the intersection, head right to the end of this path to find this Materia at the edge of the cliff. _Allows you to use toxin-related spells._

title: Lv. 1 HP Up Materia
description: Type: Complete (Purple) After the intersection with the Sandhog Pies, head left, then drop down the left-hand side and down the ledges. This Materia will be at the bottom. _Increases your max HP. This bonus cannot exceed +30% when more than one is equipped._

title: Lv. 2 Steal Materia
description: Prerequisite: Win the Chocobo Cup during Chapter 8 Type: Command (Yellow) In the back of Gus' office at the top of Solemntude Manor. _Allows you to take items from enemies with Steal._

title: Lv. 1 Subversion Materia
description: **WARNING: All collectibles after the Cooling Chamber are *MISSABLE*, including this materia! It will be impossible to get it after you've entered the Reactor Core! Type:** Magic (Green) At the very end of the hallway where the [Rest Spot](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=330161) is. Check the southwestern end to find it at the dead-end, past the nearby. _Allows you to use subversive spells._

title: Lv. 1 Warding Materia
description: Prerequisite: Visit the Gongaga Reactor Type: Command Materia (Blue) Reach this ledge by bouncing off the [Big Mushroom](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=330550) to the north using a Chocobo. _Grants resistance to the linked Materia's detrimental status effect._

title: Lv. 3 Prayer Materia
description: Type: Command (Yellow) Complete [Training Facility B-T](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=330817) to unlock this chest. _Allows you to restore the party's HP with Pray._

title: Lv. 1 Level Boost Materia
description: Type: Support Materia (Blue) Can be found inside the crater. _Increases the level of the linked Materia by one. Has no effect when paired with Materia at maximum level._

title: Lv. 3 Healing Materia
description: Type: Green (Magic) On the ledge up the climbable wall. _??_

title: Lv. 2 Fortification Materia
description: From the Phoenix Down, head down the stairs and then clamber down the green wall to find this Materia at the bottom.

title: Lv. 2 Empowerment Materia
description: Type: Green (Magic) After passing through the second gate, head forward up the stairs and then climb up the right-hand wall. At the very top, defeat the four Two-Faces, then grab this Materia in the eastern corner of the battlefield. _??_

title: Lv. 1 Level Boost Materia
description: On the upper floor of the barn, between the fireplace and the bed.

title: Lv. 1 HP<=>MP Materia
description: NOTICE: This Materia only appears during Chapter 11. It is not available during Chapter 1. Type: Complete Materia (Purple In front and to the left of the Mako spring in the cave, with the cutscene. _Swaps your HP and MP values._

title: Lv. 1 Warding Materia
description: After climbing up the cliff, head forward southeast and up the hill to find this Materia at the top.

title: Lv. 1 Barrier Materia
description: After the hallway filled with wooden boxes, defeat the Black Bat and Rictus, then head to the southeastern side of the room to find this Materia near a small rusty fence and a box dispenser.

title: Lv. 1 ATK<=>MATK Materia
description: At the very top of Ventilation Control, on 4F. To get here, roll up only using the blue ventilation ducts, without changing the power generator on the ground floor.

title: Lv. 5 Chakra Materia
description: After using the Rubystar Gear crystal to rotate your gravity for the first time, head down the stairs and fight the two Ancient Dragons. Go through the archway, then turn left and climb up the rubble to get onto the balcony. The Materia will be there.

title: Lv. 1 EXP Up Materia
description: Type: Complete (Purple) After jumping down the waterfall, head up the staircases and use the yellow Amberstar Chamber on the right to turn gravity. Head all the way to the top of the stairs to find the Materia. _Increases the amount of EXP you earn in battle._

title: Lv. 3 Steadfast Block Materia
description: At the third altar, Order's Altar, restore the southern Vessel of Life to restore an area called Safe Haven. Head down the corridor and take the second door on the left to find this Materia in the arena, guarded by two Cthonilizards and a Kelzmelzer.

title: Lv. 2 Subversion Materia
description: In the second Aerith and Yuffie section, in the tower to the east of altar, Salvation's Altar. Find it in the empty doorway leading nowhere.

title: Moogle Medal
description: Climb up the ladder to the left of [Chloe's Tack Shop](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=324188), then back south to the end of the walkway.

title: 5x Moogle Medals
description: Prerequisite: Complete the "A Planetological Review" story objective. In the Cosmo Canyon Observatory's treasury, on the upper-most floor.

title: 3x Moogle Medals
description: Part of the [Rustladen Reservoir cache site](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323827).

title: Sleek Saber
description: Party Member: Cloud Inside a chest at the Abandoned Docks. _A republic-era blade polished into a refined shape and sheen._ Ability: Firebolt Blade — Imbue your sword with fire and lightning while slicing a foe. Can use while airborne. Proficiency Bonus: Exploit an enemy's weakness.

title: Timeless Rod
description: Party Member: Aerith Inside a chest, to the right of Chloe's Tack Shop. _A charming staff carved from a millennia-old tree._ Ability: Chrono Aegis — Raise a barrier that damages and temporarily freezes enemies who attempt to strike you. Proficiency Bonus: Strike an enemy and inflict Stop.

title: Hi-Caliber Rifle
description: Party Member: Barret Purple chest on the shore within the swamp. _A retro firearm repurposed from a republic-era weapon._ Ability: Bonus Round — Load your weapon with unique bullets that increase stagger and power up your attacks. Proficiency Bonus: Fire 20 bullets.

title: Sylph Gloves
description: Party Member: Tifa Next to the top of the ladder leading down to the floor below. _Gloves that slice through the air to deliver sharp strikes._ Ability: Reverse Gale — Knock enemies into the air or bring them crashing down with a wind-aspected attack. Launches enemies toward you. Can use while airborne. Proficiency Bonus: Exploit an enemy's weakness to Wind.

title: Renegade's Collar
description: Party Member: Red XIII To the left of the Rest Spot. _A collar made during the war as a symbol of revolt._ Ability: Crescent Claw — Slash at a foe. Deplete the gauge while in Vengeance Mode to increase potency and range. Proficiency Bonus: Finish off an enemy.

title: Empress's Scepter
description: Party Member: Aerith In the back corner of Aerith's room, once the group has booked a night at the Inn. If you already have the Empress's Scepter, this will have 2,500 gil in it instead. _A historied staff once offered as a gift to Her Majesty._ Ability: Radiant Ward — Conjur a ward that grants invincibility while casting spells. Strengthens Aerith's basic attack. Proficiency Bonus: Finish off an enemy with a standard attack launched from within the ward.

title: Rune Blade
description: NOTICE: This weapon is _MISSABLE_. If you don't pick it up for free here, you'll have to spend money for it at a Weapons Shop! Party Member: Cloud To the right of the Rest Spot after the parade. Can only be collected during the events of Chapter 4. This weapon is _MISSABLE_ as you cannot return to it after encountering the Chapter 4 boss. If you do, you'll have to buy it later from a Weapons Vendor. _A greatsword inscribed with characters from a mystical, ancient script._ Ability: Disorder — Deliver a devastating attack while switching modes. Fills the ATB gauge when the attack connects. Can be used while airborne. Proficiency Bonus: Strike with Attack or Strong Attack after switching modes.

title: Wizard's Rod
description: Party Member: Aerith Facing the Rest Spot, head around the left-hand corner to find the chest. _A magical staff once wielded by a formidable spellcaster_ Ability: Lustrous Shield — Conjure a magical shield that keeps enemies at bay and stops projectiles. Proficiency Bonus: Defend against an enemy's attack (one time only while active).

title: Twin Viper
description: Party Member: Yuffie Next to the switch you have to pull to get the ascending ropes working. _A throwing star that fuses two crescent-shaped sickles into one deadly weapon._ Ability: Windstorm — Create a gust of wind that damages nearby enemies and launches them toward you. Proficiency Bonus: Strike two or more enemies.

title: Barrage Blaster
description: Party Member: Barret On the lower-most floor of the Railway Control Tower with the yellow ascension ropes. _A heavy-artillery firearm equipped with multiple barrels for maximum lethality._ Ability: Lifesaver — Temporarily increase your HP and take damage intended for other party members. Proficiency Bonus: Use your HP to heal allies (one time only while active).

title: Amethyst Collar
description: Party Member: Red XIII Requires: Start [Of Robed Men and Ransoms](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325424) In the northwestern dead-end in the first room of the [Old South Corel Mine](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323797). _An elegant collar embedded with mystical purple gemstones._ Ability: Supernal Fervor — Grant Haste on all party members. Can only be used during Vengeance Mode. Costs 2 ATB. Proficiency Bonus: Activate on a three-person party.

title: Umbral Blade
description: Party Member: Cloud Next to the entrance into Dio's Solemnitude Manor. _A mystifying sword forged from a gem that emits an eerie glow._ Ability: Prime Mode — Strengthen Punisher Mode. Hold down Attack to deliver three consecutive strikes. Increases Berserk potency. Proficiency Bonus: Finish off an enemy while active.

title: Vulcan Cannon
description: Party Member: Barret At the end of the ramp leading down to the [Scrapyard Prison Cell](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325427). _A gunarm that fires faster as its three barrels begin to rotate._ Ability: Charging Uppercut — Rush toward an enemy and launch them into the air with a furious blow. Increases Charge. Proficiency Bonus: Top up the Overcharge gauge.

title: Crystal Megaphone
description: Party Member: Cait Sith Prerequisite: Complete the "A Planetological Review" story objective. In the Cosmo Canyon Observatory's treasury, on the lower-most floor. _A megaphone whose gorgeous gems add a soothing resonance to the user's voice._ Ability: Moogle Magic — Use an equipped Summon's Ability. Can only use while riding the Moogle during battles in which Summons are available. Cooldown increases with each use. Proficiency Bonus: Finish off an enemy.

title: Kaiser Knuckles
description: NOTICE: This weapon is _MISSABLE_. If you don't pick it up for free here, you'll have to spend money for it at a Weapons Shop! Party Member: Tifa In a purple chest up the southeastern steps from the arena where you fight your first Daemonic Entity (the green on-foot humanoid monster). This is the first fight you'll have in the cargo hold of the ship. _Gloves fitted with sharp metal spikes to pack an extra punch._ Ability: Overpower — Use with other attacks to more effectively pressure enemies. Can use while airborne. Proficiency Bonus: Follow up with Attack after using the weapon ability.

title: Silver Collar
description: Party Member: Red XIII Awarded for winning first place with no tie in [Run Wild's](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323965) Free-for-All challenge. _A collar wrought from a high-quality metal said to ward off magical fiends._ Ability: Chilling Roar — Retaliate with ice shards whenever hit by an attack. Charges the Vengeance Gauge when a counterstrike lands. Proficiency Bonus: Exploit an enemy's weakness.

title: Bird of Prey
description: Party Member: Yuffie In a chest at the back of the house with the Rest Stop in it. _A tricky throwing star wielded by seasoned hunters of the forest._ Ability: Doppelganger — Conjure a clone of yourself that temporarily mimics your actions. Can use while airborne. Proficiency Bonus: Finish off an enemy while the clone is present.

title: Red Megaphone
description: Party Member: Cait Sith In the shaded cave accessible via the river. _A megaphone that helps its user pour their heart into their cheering._ Ability: Moogle Kaboom — Turn your moogle into a ticking time bomb that explodes when it leaves combat. Proficiency Bonus: Strike an enemy.

title: Crystal Sword
description: Party Member: Cloud At the room with the first enemies in the reactor, vault southeast through the doorway and check the back-right corner of the new room. _A finely honed greatsword hewn from an enormous gemstone._ Ability: Infinity's End — Wind up and unleash an overhead strike. Increased damage on Stagger. Costs 2 ATB. Proficiency Bonus: Strike a staggered enemy.

title: Golden Collar
description: Party Member: Red XIII At a certain point you'll have to pull a cart on tracks to give enough length for a power cable. Pull this cart as far as you can, then use it to get up to a vent shaft. On the other side, drop down, then climb right to find the chest on top of a shipping container. _An opulent collar forged from gold found in a forest stream._ Ability: Watcher's Respite — Deplete the Vengeance Gauge to heal allies. Potency proportional to amount expended. Proficiency Bonus: Activate when the Vengeance Gauge is full.

title: Tiger Fangs
description: Party Member: Tifa **WARNING: All of the chests obtained in Tifa's reactor run are *MISSABLE*, including this one! It will be impossible to open this chest after you've entered the Reactor Core! In the long flooded corridor with the red walkways, grapple up through the ceiling, then face northeast. On an upper ledge will be this chest: use the grapple points on your left to get up to it. _Savage gloves inspired by the sharp teeth of a beast of prey._ Ability: Chi Trap — Create an orb of materialized chi that deals damage on contact. Proficiency Bonus:** Strike an enemy.

title: Resounding Megaphone
description: Party Member: Cait Sith Among the bushes west of the Telephone Booth. _A megaphone that allows the user's voice to echo out across hill and vale._ Ability: Moogle Mine — Use the moogle to scatter landmines that explode upon enemy contact. Moderately increases stagger. Proficiency Bonus: Stagger an enemy with a mine explosion.

title: Mystic Collar
description: Party Member: Red XIII *WARNING:* This Weapon is _missable!_ If you do not get it before returning the Ruby Gi Statue to Bugenhagen, it will be inaccessible until you unlock Chapter Select! Up on the ledge to the right of the exit door. _A dignified collar once worn by Watchers of the Vale_ Ability: Watcher's Spirit — Deplete the Vengeance Gauge to increase allies' ATB. Potency proportional to the amount expended. Proficiency Bonus: Activate when the Vengence Gauge is full.

title: Calamitous Bazooka
description: Party Member: Barret At the first gate, in the lower area just across from it, guarded by a Stinger and a pair of Two-Faces. _A wicked firearm imbued with the rancor of a tribe of fallen warriors._ Ability: Smackdown — Strike the ground and send nearby enemies flying. Proficiency Bonus: Strike two or more enemies.

title: Ceremonial Staff
description: Party Member: Aerith To the left of the Rest Spot in the Village of the Gi, near the shoreline. _A sacred staff used as part of a ritual prayer to the planet._ Ability: ATB Ward — Conjure a ward. Fill ATB changes within the ward to increase your allies' ATB gauges. Proficiency Bonus: Activate the effects of the ward (one time only while ward is on the field).

title: Crystal Gloves
description: Party Member: Tifa Next to the fence of the Shinra facility across the bridge, in front of a wooden shelter inside some scaffolding. _Gloves studded with gemstones that house magic power._ Ability: Unfettered Fury — Imbue your unbridled attacks with non-elemental magic. Increases stagger. Proficiency Bonus: Stagger an enemy with a standard attack while Unfettered Fury is active.

title: Igneous Saber
description: Party Member: Cloud On top of the structure between the two climbable walls. _A curved greatsword forged from hardened volcanic magma._ Ability: Blade Burst — Unleash a wave of non-elemental mako energy at an enemy in front of you with a slash of your sword. Proficiency Bonus: Finish off an enemy.

title: Golden Megaphone
description: Party Member: Cait Sith After rolling through the first duct and defeating the Bahba Velamyu, call the Moogle stand on the button on the west side of the room to drop a crate in. Pick it up and then toss it onto the button partway up the southeastern wall. This will open up a door with this chest behind it! _A glimmering megaphone used by some to scare off the most ferocious of beasts._ Ability: Moogle Knuckle — Use the moogle to deliver a fistful of pain. Increased stagger damage bonus. Proficiency Bonus: Strike a staggered enemy.

title: Plumose Rod
description: Party Member: Aerith In Hojo's secret laboratory. Unlock it by completing all Evaluation challenges in the [Mako Research Combat Simulator](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348951). _A bewitching staff decorated with the feathers of a bird known for its beautiful song._ Ability: Ray of Judgement — Fire an energy burst that hits multiple times. Increased stagger damage bonus. Proficiency Bonus: Strike a staggered enemy.

title: Crystalline Cross
description: Party Member: Yuffie Found in the northeastern room of the backstage Utilidor area on 1F. You're able to explore this area during Chapter 12's story. _A throwing star fitted with four sharp, gem-hewn blades._ Ability: Banishment — ATB spent on other commands increases damage dealt. Affinity changed with Ninjutsu. Can use while airborne. Shares gauge with Purification. Max Level : III. Proficiency Bonus: Strike an enemy with a Level III attack.

title: Slipstream Saber
description: Party Member: Cloud After using the Rubystar to turn gravity, go down the stairs and to the vines. Climb directly up to reach a balcony with this chest on it to the right. If you already have this, you'll find 6,500 gil instead. _A greatsword whose power has been greatly enhanced by the mako coursing through its blade._ Ability: Counterstance — Brace for attacks and retaliate. Activate at the right time to reduce damage. Can use while airborne. Proficiency Bonus: Unleash a counterattack.

title: Járngreipr
description: Party Member: Tifa After first descending into the blustery Lifestream area, you'll fight some Riot Troopers and a Type G Slug-Ray. Defeat them, then vault into the next area: the Járngreipr gloves are on the left-hand side. If you already have this, 6,500 gil will be here instead. _Gloves embedded with strength-enhancing energy cores._ Ability: True Strike — Deliver a tremendous blow at close range. Increased stagger damage bonus. Proficiency Bonus: Strike a staggered enemy.

title: Gambanteinn
description: Party Member: Aerith At the second altar, Mercy's Altar, restore the western Vessel of Life to restore a tower, called Wall of Denial. Descend to the bottom, then check under the stairs to find this chest. If you already have this, 6,500 gil will be here instead. _A superior staff made by the Cetra to help them protect the planet._ Ability: Noble Sacrifice — Sacrifice yourself to revive fallen allies, restore their HP, and remove detrimental status effects. Costs. 2 ATB. Proficiency Bonus: Activate when an ally is in critical condition or unconscious.

title: Battle Cry
description: Party Member: Barret In the second Cloud section, after crossing a gap using a large box, head up the stairs and into the tower to the north. Check the northwestern corner of this tower to find the Chest. If you already have this, 6,500 gil will be here instead. _A destiny-defying firearm imbued with the power of the planet._ Ability: Turbulent Spirit — Significantly increase your ATB charge rate for a limited time. Can only be used once per battle. Proficiency Bonus: Fill 2 ATB charges while active.

title: Brísingamen
description: Party Member: Red XIII In the second Aerith / Yuffie section, repair the area using the altar, then head into the western tower. It will be in the southwestern corner of it. _An intricate collar crafted using a technology that surpasses modern scientific standards._ Ability: Reaper Touch — Deliver a deadly strike. Potency is inversely proportional to current HP. Proficiency Bonus: Activate when HP is critically low.

title: Fuma Shuriken
description: Party Member: Yuffie After going down the spiral stairs and killing the Ancient Dragon and Pantera Protector, head down the stairs into a short corridor. This chest will be in a raised section on the north side of the corridor. _A legendary throwing star said to soar like the wind, and strike down evil without making a sound._ Ability: Purification — ATB spent on other commands increases the amount of HP and MP absorbed. Can use while airborne. Shares gauge with Banishment. Max Level: III. Proficiency Bonus: Strike an enemy with a Level III attack.

title: Fafnir Rifle
description: Party Member: Barret Awarded for completing the [The Pursuit of Perfection](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=329963) Odd Job. _An ostentatious firearm crafted by a reclusive weaponsmoth._ Ability: Point Blank — Consume all ATB charges to deliver a close-range attack and send enemies flying. Proficiency Bonus: Finish off an enemy.

title: Dragon Claws
description: Party Member: Tifa Awarded for the beating the 42,000 points in [Desert Rush's](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323994) Standard difficulty. _Gorgeous gloves with a dragonscale design._ Ability: Starshower — Unleash a flurry of powerful strikes. Increases strength of next command executed. Proficiency Bonus: Follow up with an offensive ability or spell after using the weapon ability.

title: Crescent Sickle
description: Party Member: Yuffie Get 3,600 points in [Glide de Chocobo No. 1](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=324008). _A bewitching weapon whose blade is studded with smaller daggers._ Ability: Shooting Star — Let the Shuriken fly across the battlefield, mowing down all enemies it touches. Can use while airborne. Proficiency Bonus: Strike two or more enemies.

title: Gjallarhorn
description: Party Member: Cait Sith Return 45 tufts of Chocograss to the Chocobo Sage's [Tack Shop](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=345902). _A luxurious megaphone passed down from one Kitty King to the next._ Ability: Lady Luck — Call upon the goddess of fortune to temporarily increase allies' critical hit rate. Proficiency Bonus: Activate on a three-person party.

title: Chapter 8: All That Glitters
description: Level: 27-29 _Following in the robed individuals' footsteps, the party leaves the down-at-heel settlement of North Corel for the glittering opulence of the Gold Saucer—the theme park that never sleeps. Rising high above the wastelands, it has truly earned its sobriquet as the "gilded paradise"._

title: Chapter 2: A New Journey Begins
description: Level: 15-19 _After a long night, Cloud and company awake the next morning to the sleepy, bucolic town of Kalm. Aware that a long journey lies ahead of them, they decide to take advantage of this quiet moment to prepare for what awaits._

title: Chapter 3: Deeper into Darkness
description: Level: 19-20 _The team proceeds into the Mythril Mine to pursue Sephiroth. Once famous for the eponymous ore it produced, the site is now nothing more than a fiend-filled monument to a world that was destroyed by Shinra's greed._

title: Chapter 4: Dawn of a New Era
description: Level: 21-23 _The party exits the Mythril Mine to discover the Junon region, a windswept coastal territory where the shadow of Shinra looms large. Once a symbol of republic freedom, this land now stands as a testament to Shinra's prosperity—and the carnage wrought to achieve it._

title: Chapter 5: Blood in the Water
description: Level: 23 _Cloud and company continue their pursuit of the robed individuals aboard a cruise ship. Their destination: Costa del Sol, a seaside resort where summer never ends and the party never stops. Though arrival in paradise is not until the next morning, the onboard festivities have already begun._

title: Chapter 6: Fool's Paradise
description: Level: 24 _After an unexpectedly eventful voyage, the cruise ship drops anchor at the resort paradise of Costa del Sol. Seeking respite among the sun and sand, the party makes way for the city center._

title: Chapter 7: Those Left Behind
description: Level: 26-27 _As they leave Costa del Sol, the party bids farewell to the sun and fun in exchange for a new member: Yuffie. With this energetic ninja in tow, they follow the black robes in the direction of Mt. Corel—a once-thriving coal mine, and a location that evokes more than a few emotions in Barret._

title: Chapter 9: The Planet Stirs
description: Level: 31-35 _Following a painful goodbye, the party resumes their journey—though to where, none of them can say. For the moment, they push southward, away from Corel._

title: Chapter 10: Watcher of the Vale
description: Level: 36-39 _As the scale of the conflict continues to swell, the party cannot help but feel they are embroiled in a battle for the future of the planet. Thus, where better to see guidance than Cosmo Canyon, the home of planetology?_

title: Chapter 11: The Long Shadow of Shinra
description: Level: 39-42 _The Party makes its way to Nibelheim on Cait Sith's word that there will be a Shinra terminal via which they can ascertain the temple's location. Though Cloud and Tifa agree to the plan, they hold out little hope as they approach the village Sephiroth burned to the ground five years ago._

title: Chapter 12: A Golden Key
description: Level: 42-44 _The party discovers that in order to access the Temple of the Ancients—in which rests the Black Materia—they will need the keystone, a relic last seen at the Gold Saucer. Meanwhile, war is brewing in the world. Wutai has publicly declared their intent to topple Shinra and the city of Midgar, yet the company is unfazed. Their focus remains locked on one thing only—reaching the temple and discovering the promised land._

title: Chapter 13: Where Angels Fear to Tread
description: Level: 45-49 _Rufus orders all hands on deck in his effort to reach that which he deems "the promised land": the fabled Temple of the Ancients. In pursuit of the Black Materia allegedly contained therein, Cloud and company follow Shinra's lead. Though the two parties' motives may differ, their destination is the same, with both groups set to coalesce in the land up north._

title: Chapter 14: End of the World
description: Level: 49 _Having entrusted Cloud with her White Materia, Aerith ventures alone into the depths of the Sleeping Forest, determined to put a stop to Sephiroth's plans._

title: Chapter 1: Fall of a Hero
description: _After a harrowing battle in Midgar with an otherworldly twist, the group continues their pursuit of Sephiroth. They make a stop in the village of Kalm, where Cloud reveals his connection to their uncanny enemy and what happened on that fateful day in Nibelheim five years ago._

description: Prerequisite: Rest the night in [Under Junon's Inn](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323909) Level: 21 _I'm looking to hire a bodyguard. My boy Salmon needs to make a delivery, and I don't want a fiend even looking at him the wrong way. Come and see me if you're interested._ Rewards: - Entry intro [The Crow's Nest](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323895) - 10 Party EXP - 500 EXP - Barret affinity - Sharpshooter's Companion Vol. I - 3x Mythril Ore - 2x Rubies

title: Stuck In A Rut
description: Level: 20 _Been making deliveries since way back when, but now that one of my carriage's wheels broke, I've had to suspend service. If I could get my hands on a replacement, I suppose I could fix the damn thing, but honestly, maybe this is all for the best..._ Rewards: - Queensguard Bangle - 10 Party EXP - 500 EXP - Aerith affinity

title: Of Robed Men and Ransoms
description: Level: 28 One of the robed fellows I've been looking after has been abducted. Whatever damn fool that did it left behind a note demanding money, but I'm in no position to pay. There's no telling what'll happen to the man if I don't, though, so if someone out there's willing to track down and rescue the poor bastard, you'd be doing us a favor. Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 600 EXP - Tale of the Red Warrior Vol. II - Red XIII affinity

title: A Rare Card Lost
description: Prerequisite: [Wrangle](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325590) and [race](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325858) Piko the Chocobo _Got beat bad at Queen's Blood, but the real stinger was when I had to give up the rare card I'd staked on the match. I'm looking for a pro to win it back on my behalf. If you think you've got what it takes, drop by the bar._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 400 EXP - Card #107: Chocobo & Moogle - Tifa affinity - Thorin's Card Shop

title: Lifeline in Peril
description: Prerequisite: [Wrangle](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325590) and [race](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325858) Piko the Chocobo Level: 18 _The mako pipeline upon which Kalm and her people rely has sprung a leak, and we are in desperate need of a technician - or failing that, someone with a modicum of skill - to perform emergency repairs. The welfare of our residents hangs in the balance!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 300 EXP - 3,000 gil - Barret affinity

title: Livestock's Bane
description: Prerequisite: [Wrangle](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325590) and [race](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325858) Piko the Chocobo Level: 8 _A clever fiend of some sort's been preying on my livestock of late, and if I can't put a stop to it, my farm's doomed. Seems clear a run-of-the-mill hunter won't cut it, so I'm in the market for a merc with solid tracking skills._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 400 EXP - 1x Owl Bracer - Red XIII affinity

title: Flowers from the Hill
description: Prerequisite: [Wrangle](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325590) and [race](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325858) Piko the Chocobo Level: 17 _My sister's lookin' for help. Not sure what the trouble is. Didn't wanna confide in me for whatever reason. Honestly, she hasn't been herself since Mom left. They did dang near everything together._ Chloe of Bill's Ranch wants to make a gift for her older brother in order to lift his spirits. Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 300 EXP - Telluric Scriptures Vol. I - Aerith affinity

title: Where the Wind Blows
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Livestock's Bane](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=325860) Level: 22 _A good friend of mine's in need of assistance with a repair job, but with my health trouble, I fear I'd do more harm than good. If you're willing to lend her a hand in my stead, come and see me at the inn. And quickly, please._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 300 EXP - Whistlewind Scarf - Red XIII affinity

title: The Saga of Seaside Inn
description: Prerequisite: Begin [Chapter 7: Those Left Behind](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=326927) Level: 31 This sidequest cannot be fully completed until you reach Chapter 9. _Johnny's Seaside Inn is currently undergoing a complete renovation to better cater to you, out beloved customers! And, uh...we could use a little help. Help that isn't me. And my "me" I mean "we". And by "we" I mean...uh, it'll be easier to explain when you meet the gang. And by "you" I mean my one true bro, Cloud! Don't leave me hanging!"_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,000 EXP - Card #134: J-Squad - Yuffie affinity - Treasure Trove Collector's Items displays

title: Calling All Frogs
description: Prerequisite: Rest the night in [Under Junon's Inn](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323909) Level: 22 _Ribbit ribbit, ribbit ribbit ribbit? Ribbit! Ribbit ribbit. Ribbit ribbit ribbit, ribbit!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 500 EXP - Tifa affinity

title: The Hardest Sell
description: Prerequisite: Rest the night in [Under Junon's Inn](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323909) Level: 23 _So there's this lighthouse that's my favourite hangout spot, but now some rando calling themselves the "Merc of Junon" has rolled up and claimed it as their new HQ. I don't know what their deal is, but they're sure not doing jack about the fiends in the area, so I'd love it if someone could tell 'em to, you know, beat it or whatever_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 500 EXP - Merc Chocobo Gear (Cap, Overalls & Legwraps) - Red XIII affinity

title: Dreaming of Blue Skies
description: Prerequisites: - Rest the night in [Under Junon's Inn](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323909) Level: 23 _Our beloved condor has not graced the skies above Junon in quite some time. We worry for her welfare and wish to hire someone to prepare a culinary feast that she will find too tempting to resist. Those willing to provide assistance are invited to join us on Condor Hill._ Rewards: - ??

title: Rendezvous in Costa del Sol
description: Prerequisite: Reach Chapter 7 Level: 25 _Hey lovebirds, we need your help in creating our next line of classic swimwear! All you have to do is go on a very special date we've planned that's sure to bring you and your partner closer together than ever. So come and see us on the beach if you're in the mood for romance!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 700 EXP - The Art of Swordplay Vol. II - Aerith affinity

title: Bodybuilders in a Bind
description: Prerequisite: Complete the [Rendezvous in Costa del Sol](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=327202) side quest Level: 26 _It's time to muscle maximize—or at least it was, until a bunch of fiends showed up and started scaring our members. Even the most passionate builder would struggle to get into a rhythm with those things hanging around, so we need an able-bodied merc to come save the day—and our gains._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 500 EXP - Tifa affinity - 3x Celeris (beat Amina in the crunch-off)

title: Missing: Mr. Birdie
description: Prerequisite: Begin [Chapter 9](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=326929) Level: 30 _Mr. Birdie didn't come home for dinner, and no one knows where he is! We're worried something bad might've happened to him. Can anyone help us find him? Please?_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 900 EXP - Lv. 1 Level Boost Materia - Barret affinity

title: The Pursuit of Perfection
description: Level: 31 _I've been striving to create the greatest weapon that ever was, but despite my best efforts, I've yet to make any meaningful progress. There's an essential element I'm missing, the seed of inspiration—but I *know* it's out there! I just need something or someone to help me grasp it!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,100 EXP - Fafnir Rifle (Barret) - Barret affinity

title: O Chicken, Where Art Thou
description: Prerequisite: Visit the Gongaga Reactor Level: 33 _You wouldn't believe the state of my chicken coop! Poked full of fresh holes because of that black stuff from the reactor. Some were big enough for my little dears to wriggle through and run off, and now I'm scrambling to track them down before some beastie gets to them first. Oh, if only a king soul would come lend me a hand..._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,200 EXP - Lucky Amulet - Red XIII affinity

title: Teach Me, Great Warrior
description: Prerequisite: Visit the Gongaga Reactor Level: 34 _I'm looking for someone to teach me the ways of the warrior—to help me reach my full potential! No matter the suffering, no matter the sacrifice, I'm willing to do whatever it takes!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,200 EXP - Secrets of the Ninja Vol. IV - Yuffie affinity

title: The Spice of Life
description: Prerequisite: - Visit the Gongaga Reactor - Complete the [Teach Me, Great Warrior](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=330265) odd job Level: 35 _Gongaga mushroom soup may seem like a simple dish to most people, but making it is harder than you'd expect. My attempts aren't coming together, and the flavor is always just a little bit off. I don't know if something's missing, or if I added one too many ingredients, or what..._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,300 EXP - Chakra Materia Earrings - Aerith affinity

title: Bonds of Trust
description: _Wanna put your chocobo-riding skills to the test? Then why not take on a ring course? I had it built custom for my daughter, but since she's not putting it to use these days, I figure anyone with a mind up to their game out to take advantage. Don't be a stranger!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,500 EXP - Tale of the Red Warrior Vol. VI - Yuffie affinity

title: Lament of the Damned
description: Prerequisite: Dock at Costa del Sol during Chapter 12 Level: 44 _Tell me you've heard it too. The woman in the manor, weeping or wailing or...I don't know. I don't_ want _to know. really—can't bring bring myself to even go into the manor these days. But someone needs to get to the bottom of this...or I'll never be able to sleep again._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 3,300 EXP - The Art of Swordplay Vol. VI - Barret affinity - Shinra Manor Combat Simulator

title: My White-Haired Angel
description: Prerequisite: Explore and leave [Shinra Manor](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=345689). Level: 41 _The darling little cat I feed from time to time hasn't come around for a while, and it's making me sick with worry. I know they can be independent souls, but she's never been one to turn down a good meal..._ Rewards: - Aerith's Theme sheet music - 10 Party EXP - 2,200 EXP - Way of the First Vol. VI - Tifa affinity

title: Esoteric Secrets of the Elders
description: _Chocobos are lovely creatures, but they can be a handful if you don't know the proper techniques. I offer personal training tailored to your specific needs. Sign up now for a special course at my retreat which includes three meals, afternoon naps, and a luxurious pool open all hours of the day._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,000 EXP - Yuffie affinity

title: Absence of a Sign
description: Prerequisite: Complete the [Cave of the Gi](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323857) Level: 38 _Portents of calamitous ruin have been sighted in the vale of late—dreadful fiends whose very presence heralds doom. But all is not yet lost, for in times past we have observed celestial phenomena indicative of the great mother's triumph over such forces. We request assistance with spotting and photographing said phenomena; seek out the mentor Caesar for more information._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,700 EXP - Tarot Cards - Aerith affinity

title: From Whence Life Flows
description: Prerequisite: Complete the [Cave of the Gi](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323857) Level: 38 _It's been entirely too long since I've done some old-fasioned fieldwork, and I'd like to correct that. Unfortunately, I seem to have misplaced my tools. Drop by and lend a hand, won't you?_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,700 EXP - Fortunes Untold Vol. IV - Red XIII affinity

title: Promises to Keep
description: Prerequisite: Complete the [From Whence Life Flows](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348554) Odd Job Level: 42 _Hey Nanaki, the survey team came back early—said there's Gi down in the canyon basin. Come see me as soon as you read this!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 1,900 EXP - Mythical Amulet - Red XIII affinity

title: Trouble in Paradise
description: Prerequisite: Begin Chapter 12 Level: 44 _It is my solemn charge to keep our slice of beachside paradise free from all manner of unpleasantness. To that end, I employed a freelancer to resolve a simple matter...which they have failed to do in a timely fashion. And so I must once more seek outside assistance—this time to deal with _two_ problems. Rest assured you will be well compensated._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,600 EXP - Secrets of the Ninja Vol. VI - Yuffie affinity

title: Gold Cup or Bust
description: Prerequisite: Begin Chapter 12 _Hey Cloud, if you're reading this and I have told you in person yet—we got permission to race in the Gold Cup! It's a major racing event and a real honor, believe me. When you're read to challenge the best of the best, I'll be waiting for you in Chocobo Square!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,900 EXP - Tifa affinity

title: Hustle and Grind
description: Prerequisite: Begin Chapter 12 Level: 43 _Beck's Business wants YOU! We are currently recruiting respectable businessmen and women eager to engage in respectable business activities. Salary is commiserate on performance; we offer commissary compensation. Work hard and you'll make bank! Drop by our recruitment center and submit your application today!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,400 EXP - Sharpshooter's Companion Vol VI - Barret affinity

title: Tides of War and Worry
description: Prerequisite: Begin Chapter 12 _Grown-ups have been talking about war with Wutai a lot lately, and it's really getting my friends down. I wanna try and take their minds of it all—do something fun—but I'm not sure what. If anyone has ideas, I'm all ears._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,400 EXP - Yuffie affinity

title: Escape from Endless Writer's Block
description: Prerequisite: Begin Chapter 12 _I came to Gongaga to find inspiration for my next children's book, but even in this verdant forest I feel the walls closing in all around me! I'm trapped in a mental prison—a maze of my own making—and need a muse to deliver me from the creative doldrums!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,600 EXP - Crescent Moon Charm - Barret affinity

title: Victim of Circumstance
description: Prerequisite: Begin Chapter 12 Level: 45 _Was headed to the airstrip when I had a run-in with one hell of a fiend. Led it on a merry chase until my baby's engine gave up the ghost, and now I'm stranded here. I can fix her, but so long as that bastard's still around, I doubt I'll get far regardless. If anyone can come and bail me out, I'd be in your debt._ Begin by going to [Fiend Location 1](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=349184). Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,900 EXP - Lv. 1 Magnify Materia - Yuffie affinity

title: Beneath Still Waters
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Tides of War and Worry](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348968) Level: 45 _Be advised: a fearsome fiend is presently contained within Crater Cape. Civilians are strongly encouraged to avoid this area until the threat has been addressed. Active duty and retired military are requested to render assistance._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,400 EXP - Telluric Scriptures Vol. VI - Aerith affinity

title: Sand and Circuses
description: Prerequisite: Complete the [Trouble in Paradise](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348965) side quest Level: 45 _Everyone's favorite dustbowl asshole is throwing a "party,", and there's a "prize" up for grabs that I need to win. So I joined the festivities—several times—but just couldn't hak it. "We'll meet again"—that's what she tried to tell me, but I guess it's you I hope I'll meet again first, merc. Come and find me, please._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,600 EXP - Way of the Fist Vol. VI - Tifa affinity

title: Woodland Vigil
description: Prerequisite: Complete the [Escape from Endless Writer's Block](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=348972) side quest Level: 44 _Attention GYC members--as you may have heard, we've received reports of especially dangerous fiends near the village. I've decided to personally look into this, so I'll be heading to the observation tower. Unit leaders are in charge while I'm away._ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 2,600 EXP - Fortunes Untold Vol. VI - Aerith affinity

title: The Pirate King's Treasure
description: Prerequisite: Begin Chapter 12 Level: 46 This Side Quest is technically a Discovery, but acts more like an Odd Job. Because of this, it isn't logged on any Noticeboard in the game. Rewards: - Corsair's Compass

title: Can't Stop Won't Stop
description: Prerequisite: During [Chapter 12](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=326932), complete the big match in the [Musclehead Colosseum](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=323993). Level: 46 _Fellow disciples of diversions and delights, to you I issue a challenge! I, once a man of middling achievements, now lauded as a champion of champions, have set new high scores in the most beloved of the Gold Saucer's many attractions. Come, players, and pit your skills against mine, and strive to claim my title of Ultimate Party Animal!_ Rewards: - 10 Party EXP - 3,100 EXP - Lv. 1 Gambler Materia
